When charges are full or the shield disappears, make a special attack and clear all charges. At 1 charge, deal #1 damage that always hits to enemies within 3 units ahead of self. At 2 charges, deal an additional #2 damage that always hits to enemies within 5 units ahead of self. At max charges, deal an additional #3 damage that always hits to enemies within 8 units ahead of self. Active: Grant a #4 HP shield, lasting for 5 seconds.

skill.name: Sinister Folklore
skill.description:
Active: Instantly complete a rapid reload, gaining 3 extra rounds; attacks expend these extra rounds first. Attacks with extra rounds deal 2 instances of #1 damage to their targets (does not stack with slug or birdshot ammo).
Passive: Every reload grants a shield that absorbs #2 points of damage for #3 seconds, as well as granting friendly units behind self #4 damage reduction for #5 seconds.

skill.name: Sinister Folklore
skill.description:
Active: Immediately perform a quick reload and gain 3 extra shots in the magazine. Extra shots are expended first, dealing 2 instances of #1 damage (does not stack with the effects of slug or birdshot ammo).
Passive: Each reload grants self a shield that can absorb #2 points of damage for #3 seconds. This shield also provides #4 of damage reduction to self and all units behind self for #5 seconds.
Each reload deals one instance of #6 damage to all enemies in an area in front of self while also applying #7 of armor as shield bash damage (does not stack with the effects of slug or birdshot ammo), as well as a knockback effect and a speed reduction effect of #8 for #9 seconds.

skill2.name: Shattered Illusion
skill2.description: After each reload, increase self rate of fire by #1 for 8 seconds, increase self armor by #2 points for 99 seconds, and gain 50% of current armor value as a shield for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Suppressive Impact
skill.description: While the skill is active, every normal attack deals 4 instance of individual #1 damage to her target, lasting #2 seconds. (When equipped with "Tactical Defense Shield", the initial cooldown of Punitive Impact is reduced to 4 seconds. While the skill is active, all attacks are critical hits.)

skill.name: Assault Focus
skill.description: Increase rate of fire by #1 for #2 seconds.

skill.name: Pigeonwing Recording
skill.description:
Passive: 
Gain 3 Pigeonwings upon the start of the battle. When an allied unit has received a stat-decreasing debuff, that unit gains #1 Rate of Fire for 4 seconds, stacking up to 1 time. This boost does not trigger other passive effects, and cannot take effect on the same unit within 3 seconds. When C-93 receives 1 stat-decreasing debuff, trigger the aforementioned effect on herself and gain 6 Pigeonwing. Only up to #2 Pigeonwings can be stocked at once.
Active:
Increase all allied units' damage by #3 for #4 seconds, and expend all currently stocked Pigeonwings. For every Pigeonwing expended, an ally gains 4 Rate of Fire, stacking up to 2 times, and this can stack with the Passive variant. This skill prioritizes units that have not been buffed by the Pigeonwings, and thereafter the units with the highest DPS. Once the skill ends, C-93 replenishes 3 Pigeonwings. (After equipping the ""Glorious Banner"", Pigeonwings additionally increase critical damage by 10%.)

skill.name: D-Fense
skill.description: Clear all negative status effects on self and grant self a maxed-out forcefield lasting 1 seconds. Once the forcefield disappears, raise self evade by #1, lasting #2 seconds.

skill.name: Battlefield Trendsetter
skill.description:
Raise self ROF to the maximum and increase self damage by #1. Click again to deactivate the skill.
 When skill is active, each attack adds 1 stacks of Overload. At 12 stacks of Overload, remove all stacks of Overload, stun self for 2 seconds and end the skill. While stunned, the echelon cannot move forward. 
 When the skill is deactivated, each attack removes 1 stacks of Overload.

skill.name: Muscle Pump
skill.description: Raise self damage by #1 and change target priority to enemies with the highest damage, lasting for #2 seconds.

skill.name: Muscle Pump
skill.description:
Passive: When under the effect of a damage buff, attacks deal an additional instance of #1 guaranteed damage that ignores armor.
Active: Increase damage by #2 and prioritize enemies with the highest damage for #3 seconds.

skill2.name: Creatine Supplement
skill2.description: Every 3 seconds, inflict #1 vulnerability on the enemy unit with the highest damage stat and increase damage of the ally with the highest damage stat by #2. Both the buff and debuff last 3 seconds.

skill.description: Increase damage by #1 for #2 seconds.

skill.name: Test System
skill.description:
Revision Mode: Each attack increases Focus by 1 points, with a maximum of 18 points. Automatically switches to Full Marks Mode once 18 points of Focus have been accumulated. When skill is activated in Revision Mode, expend 6 points of Focus to raise self damage by #1 and ROF by #2, lasting for 4 seconds. If there are less than 6 points of Focus, all current points of Focus are expended.
Full Marks Mode: Each attack depletes 1 points of Focus, and when 18 points of Focus have been expended, automatically switch to Revision Mode. Attacks in Full Marks Mode target the unit with the highest HP, and consecutive attacks against the same target increase damage by #3 each, to a maximum of 3 stacks. When skill is activated in this mode, increase self damage by #4, ROF by #5, and accuracy by #6, while also increasing damage taken by 30% and reducing move speed by 30%. This lasts for 6 seconds.

skill.name: Evasion Focus
skill.description: Increase evasion by #1 for #2 seconds.

skill.name: Vixen's Cunning
skill.description:
Passive: Switch to AR Mode when magazine is depleted, which lowers attack speed by 40%, raises accuracy by #1, and raises move speed by 150%
 Active: Reload and switch to MG mode, with reload time fixed at 1 seconds. After reloading, clear AR Mode stat adjustments while raising self firepower by #2, lasting #3 seconds.

skill.name: Eye of the White Mastiff
skill.description:
Passive: Attacks have a 15% chance to cause Rage, which lasts for 3 seconds. While Rage is active, every normal attack deals an instance of 40% extra damage.
 Active: Activates Eye of the White Mastiff and monitors all enemies. Attacks on monitored enemies raise self firepower, accuracy and critical chance by #1, and being attacked by a monitored enemy raises self evade by #2. Monitoring lasts for 6 seconds. While the skill is in effect, gain 5 stacks of Strain every 2 seconds, with each group of monitored enemies adding 1 stack of Strain per 2 seconds. At #3 stacks of Strain, Eye of the White Mastiff drops in effectiveness and clears all Strain stacks, inflicting a 20% decrease in ROF and accuracy for 5 seconds. This debuff can coexist with Monitoring, but the skill cannot be reactivated while the debuff is in effect.

skill.name: Eye of the White Mastiff
skill.description:
Passive: Attacks have a 15% chance to cause Rage, which lasts for 3 seconds. While Rage is active, every normal attack deals an instance of 40% extra damage.
 Active: Activates Eye of the White Mastiff and monitors all enemies. Attacks on monitored enemies raise self firepower, accuracy and critical chance by #1, and being attacked by a monitored enemy raises self evade by #2. Monitoring lasts for 6 seconds. While the skill is in effect, gain 5 stacks of Strain every 2 seconds, with each group of monitored enemies adding 1 stack of Strain per 2 seconds. At #3 stacks of Strain, Eye of the White Mastiff drops in effectiveness and clears all Strain stacks, inflicting a 20% decrease in attack speed and accuracy for 5 seconds. This debuff can coexist with Monitoring, but the skill cannot be reactivated while the debuff is in effect.

skill2.name: Blood-Curdling Howl
skill2.description:
When she monitors more than 5 targets or loses a Dummy, she becomes immune to all damage for 2 seconds and retaliates against the enemy unit with the highest damage stat, dealing #1 guaranteed damage that scales with Dummy-Links and ignores shields and armor. Retaliation damage is doubled when Rage is active.
When only DEFY members are present on the battlefield, activating Eye of the White Mastiff will cause her to taunt enemy units and reduce her damage intake by #2 for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Linked Order
skill.description:
When placed in an echelon member slot, increase the echelon leader's damage and ROF by #1 for #2 seconds, while reducing the current cooldown time of the leader's skill by #3.
When placed in the echelon leader position or if the leader is absent, raise all allies' damage by #4, lasting for #5 seconds. (When equipped with "Cloak of Glory", this unit cannot suffer dummy link losses within 10 seconds of a battle starting.)

skill.name: Butter Cream
skill.description: While the skill is active, reduce every instance damage taken by #1 points for #2 seconds. (When equipped with "Panda Dangle", every instance of damage taken by enemies is increased by 50 points while the skill is active.)

skill.name: Shimmering Waves
skill.description: Raise self ROF by #1, and buff self depending on the number of gun types on the buff tiles. For every different gun type on the tiles, gain a stack of #2 damage increase lasting for #3 seconds, with a maximum of 3 stacks. (When equipped with .233 Competition Cartridge, every different gun type on buff tiles additionally increases rate of fire by 10%, stacking up to 3 times. This effect lasts until the current battle ends.)

skill.name: Charge Focus
skill.description: Increase damage by #1 and rate of fire by #2 for #3 seconds. (After equipping VM Goggles, all allies stats are increased by an additional 5% for the duration of the skill.)

skill.name: Blue Steel Timpani
skill.description: When skill is activated, all teammates on buff tiles have their damage, attack speed and accuracy raised by #1, lasting #2 seconds.
